note_ja: Pre-correction validation interstitial set (5,459 cells). For 05d/05e diagnostic use only; not to be used for numerical values in the main text, manuscript figures, legend, or Table S1–S10. However, since the run→donor correspondence (ref/run_donor_map_v2.csv) was determined by barcode matching (94.6/96.1/96.9%) against this file, the CAP1–CAP3 labels of the validation cohort are derived from this file.
note_en: Pre-correction validation stromal set (5,459 cells). Used only by the 05d / 05e diagnostics; no number in the main text, manuscript figures, legends or Tables S1-S10 is computed from it. It is, however, the evidence behind the run-to-donor assignment in ref/run_donor_map_v2.csv (94.6 / 96.1 / 96.9% barcode overlap), so the CAP1-CAP3 labels of the validation cohort derive from it.
